evidence: The run's top-ranked cause, HEADLESS_SESSIONS at 50.8% of uncached input (4,272,000 tokens), is one of the real consumers: 40 headless review sessions with entrypoint sdk-py spawned by a hook, each costing ~106,800 uncached tokens. The audit ranked by uncached input, not cache reads or transcript size, and explicitly verified the long sessions were not the problem: their 99.4% hit ratio beat the short sessions' 90.3%, and once the two real levers (TTL break, compactions) are backed out, their residual per-turn cost (~4,500–4,950) is comparable to short sessions (3,050).
